message.content:
Here is the audit for each screen:

**1. Home**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** Text labels at the bottom of the "Shorts" cards (e.g., "Beats to Relax") are cut off by the bottom navigation bar.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The top navigation bar, search field placement, and category chips ("All", "Music", "Gaming") are structurally identical to YouTube's homepage header.
*   **(c) Improvement:** Increase the bottom padding of the content feed to ensure video titles are fully visible above the fixed navigation bar.

**2. Watch**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** The video title at the very bottom ("Elden Ring...") is partially obscured/cut off by the bottom tab bar.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The layout—featuring a main video player on the left and a vertical "Up next" playlist on the right—is a direct copy of YouTube's desktop/watch page structure.
*   **(c) Improvement:** Add a scrollable area or "Read more" expansion for the video description so it doesn't take up excessive static space below the player.

**3. Watch-Comments**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** The "Subscribe" button from the channel header is missing or not visible in this scrolled view, leaving a gap in the action bar.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The specific arrangement of "AI Recap," "Smart Chapters," and "AI Starters" buttons mimics YouTube's "Chapters" and "Key Moments" feature layout.
*   **(c) Improvement:** Pin the channel avatar and Subscribe button to the top of the screen when scrolling through comments to maintain conversion opportunities.

**4. Channel**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** The banner image area appears as a solid flat color with no visual content or placeholder imagery, looking like a missing asset.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The channel layout—circular avatar overlapping a banner, followed by name, handle stats, subscribe button, and tabbed content (Home/Videos/Popular)—is identical to YouTube's channel design.
*   **(c) Improvement:** Add a placeholder or default pattern to the banner area to make the page look complete even before the user uploads art.

**5. Profile**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** The "Edit" pencil icon on the profile picture is low contrast against the gold background, making it hard to see.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The "Your Activity" cards (Watch history, Liked videos, Subscriptions) replicate the exact card-style layout of YouTube's "You" or Library page.
*   **(c) Improvement:** Change the "Create a channel" button style to be less secondary; currently, it looks disabled compared to the red "Go Live" button.

**6. Avatar-Picker**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** The modal title "Change profile picture" is slightly misaligned or lacks sufficient padding relative to the modal's top edge.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The "Presets" grid selection and the "Upload your own" file picker interface are standard but closely resemble Google account avatar settings.
*   **(c) Improvement:** Allow users to zoom and pan their uploaded image within the circular crop preview before saving.

**7. Trending**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** The ranking numbers (1, 2) are large and bold, creating an awkward visual imbalance next to the thumbnail.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The list format—Thumbnail on left, Title/Channel/Views/Description metadata on right—is indistinguishable from YouTube's Search or Trending results.
*   **(c) Improvement:** Truncate the description text to two lines maximum to ensure consistent card heights across the list.

**8. Search**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** No critical bugs, though the metadata text density is very high compared to the thumbnail size.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The search result item layout (Thumbnail | Title | Channel Name | View Count | Timestamp | Description) is a 1:1 match for YouTube's search results page (SERP).
*   **(c) Implementation:** Add filter chips (e.g., "Today," "This week," "Channels") above the results to help users sort the content.

**9. More-Sheet**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** The "Command palette" shortcut hint at the bottom feels disconnected from the main grid of actions.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The "Explore" category pills at the bottom mimic the topic chips found on YouTube's home feed or search page.
*   **(c) Improvement:** Add icons to the "Favorites," "Library," and "History" rows to improve scannability and visual hierarchy.

**10. Favorites**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** The footer text ("Mashhad — built with Next.js...") is exposed, which looks unprofessional for a production app view.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The empty state design with a centered message and primary action button follows standard YouTube patterns for empty lists.
*   **(c) Improvement:** Hide the technical footer credits in the user-facing UI or move them strictly to an "About" settings page.

**11. Settings**
*   **(a) Visual Bug:** The toggle switches for "Autoplay" and "Reduced data" are not perfectly aligned vertically with their label text.
*   **(b) Legal Risk:** The sidebar navigation (General, Notifications, Privacy) combined with the right-side detail pane is identical to YouTube's Settings UI structure.
*   **(c) Improvement:** Add a "Clear watch history" or "Manage storage" direct action in the General tab for quicker access to maintenance tools.
